title: Bank-World: A Benchmark for Evaluating Agents on Banking Workflows
title_zh: Bank-World：一个用于评估智能体在银行工作流程表现的基准

paragraphs.en: Bank-World基准含50项银行任务，测试发现模型正确决策常未转化为正确执行，各模型表现各异。 Bank-World is a benchmark of 50 banking tasks across two simulated institutions. Completing banking work requires more than producing the right calculation: agents must reconcile records, obtain permission, execute transactions, and keep instructions and status reports consistent as circumstances change. Bank-World tests these requirements through single-turn assignments and multi-turn interactions with simulated employees who supply information, approve actions, and revise instructions. Grading combines executable checks of recorded actions and state with model judgments of task requirements, including whether valid alternative solutions satisfy them. Across 1,600 attempts by four models, we find that correct decisions often fail to become completed work. Agents charge fees twice, distribute the correct total in incorrect amounts among the recipients, and execute payments while approval is pending. Their strengths also differ: Sol leads single-turn completion, Opus has the highest observed multi-turn completion rate, and Grok succeeds across more multi-turn tasks but less consistently. Bank-World makes these differences inspectable through task-level results and worked examples connecting source evidence, agent decisions, and simulated consequences. We retain the task environments, executable graders, and full trajectories privately to reduce contamination and preserve the benchmark for future evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: Bank-World基准含50项银行任务，涵盖两家模拟机构。 完成银行工作不仅仅是得出正确的计算结果：智能体必须核对记录、获得许可、执行交易，并在情况变化时保持指令与状态报告的一致性。 Bank-World通过单轮任务以及与模拟员工的多轮交互来测试这些要求，这些员工会提供信息、批准操作并修改指令。 评分将对已记录操作和状态的自动化检查与模型对任务要求的判断相结合，包括判断有效的替代方案是否满足这些要求。 在四个模型共计1,600次尝试中，我们发现正确的决策往往未能转化为完成的工作。 智能体会重复收取手续费、向收款人分配总额正确但金额错误的款项，并在审批尚未完成时执行付款。 各模型的优势也各不相同：Sol在单轮任务完成上领先，Opus的实测多轮任务完成率最高，而Grok能完成更多不同的多轮任务，但稳定性较差。 Bank-World通过任务级结果和将来源证据、智能体决策与模拟后果相关联的完整示例，使这些差异可供检视。 我们私下保留任务环境、可执行评分器及完整轨迹，以降低数据污染风险，并为未来评估保留该基准。
